notes.title: Tech Demo- Major QoL Update
notes.content: [h3][u][b]WHAT'S NEW?[/b][/u][/h3][list][*][p]Moved game from Unreal Engine 5.2 to 5.4[/p][/*][*][p]Added Minimap System[/p][/*][*][p]Updated UI Assets[/p][/*][*][p]Added tutorial level[/p][/*][*][p]Added tutorial quests (requires manually deleting save folder)[/p][/*][*][p]Added new enemy type that uses melee weapons[/p][/*][*][p]Updated levels[/p][/*][*][p]Finalized Emissions code[/p][/*][*][p]Added new main menu[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized gameplay[/p][/*][*][p]Added new character model[/p][/*][*][p]Added animations for using specific items[/p][/*][*][p]Added placeable bed[/p][/*][*][p]Added placeable object system for customizing base[/p][/*][*][p]Added better instructions to Guide tab on the PDA[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Including more not listed...[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h3][u][b]WHAT'S FIXED?[/b][/u][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed issue with settings being set to cinematic[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed major frame drops[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed enemy AI [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed input overlap issues[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h3][u][b]WHEN IS IT COMING OUT?[/b][/u][/h3][p]The update is planned to release this Saturday 8/9/25 with more bug fixes to follow shortly after if any new major issues arise.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][u][b]THIS IS THE LAST MAJOR UPDATE FOR THE TECH DEMO[/b][/u][/h3][p]This will be the final major update for the tech demo to allow me to focus on the Early Access launch! Expect more news to be released covering Early Access on the Patreon, there you can keep up with the game's development and also receive a steam key early for supporting the game.[/p][p][url="patreon.com/ASHWAKEOfficial"]Link to Patreon[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for reading! Please wishlist and share with your friends,[/p][p]Ghost Dev[/p]

notes.title: Tech Demo- Weapon Effects Update
notes.content: [p][b][u]WHAT'S NEW?[/u][/b][/p][list][*][p]Weapon overheating with damage to weapon[/p][/*][*][p]Visual dirt build up on weapons when durability is low[/p][/*][*][p]Redesigned foliage in levels[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b][u]WHAT'S FIXED?[/u][/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed bug where menu elements don't appear[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed errors inside code to improve performance[/p][/*][*][p]Added placeholder death audio that wasn't triggering[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p][b][u]STAY TUNED FOR UPCOMING ENEMY AI UPDATE THAT INCLUDES...[/u][/b][/p][list][*][p]Newly designed enemy AI that are grouped into factions[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy cover system[/p][/*][*][p]Improved movement blending for infected[/p][/*][*][p]Creature AI attack pattern and movement improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Many more bug fixes and gameplay adjustments[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you for reading and please wishlist and share with your friends,[/p][p]Ghost Dev[/p]
